concepts.name: Latent diffusion
concepts.summary: Run the entire diffusion in a compressed VAE latent (e.g. 512x512x3 -> 64x64x4, ~48x smaller) instead of pixels. The U-Net denoises latents; the VAE handles fine pixel detail. THE reason Stable Diffusion fits on consumer GPUs.

concepts.name: VAE compression & attention cost
concepts.summary: A separately-trained VAE encodes images to a small latent and decodes back. In latent space, attention still runs over SPATIAL positions only (channels are NOT squared), and only at low-resolution levels (the attention_resolutions config).
